 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated Front-End Developer ready to take us to the next level! If you have React, Section 508/WCAG 2.0 AA expertise, and experience with federated authentication, and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Front-End Developer to build React user interfaces for employees and applicants on key initiatives supporting the client. This position will be Full-Time and Hybrid in Trenton, NJ. 
 What You’ll Do 
 User Interface Development: Build React interfaces for employee self-service and applicant-facing workflows 
 Implement forms, workflows, and dashboards from specifications and design artifacts 
 Integrate front-end components with back-end APIs Integrate with enterprise platforms like Mulesoft 
 Design System & Components: Implement and extend a component library or design system for consistent user experience 
 Build reusable, well-documented components with automated tests 
 Accessibility Conformance: Ensure all interfaces conform to Section 508 and WCAG 2.0 AA standards 
 Verify conformance with assistive technologies such as screen readers and keyboard-only navigation 
 Remediate accessibility defects and document conformance results 
 Authentication Integration: Integrate federated authentication, such as SAML or OpenID Connect, for employee and applicant sign-on 
 Handle session management, role-based views, and secure handling of user data in the browser 
 What You'll Need: 
 Required 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 
 5+ years of front-end development experience, including React in production 
 Experience implementing a component library or design system 
 Experience with Section 508 and WCAG 2.0 AA conformance, including verification with assistive technology 
 Experience integrating federated authentication 
 Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and front-end testing tools 
 Experience with a Git-based workflow and pull request review 
 Preferred 
 Public sector portal development experience 
 Experience with a state single sign-on provider 
 IAAP accessibility certification (CPACC or WAS) 
 Experience supporting State of New Jersey agencies 
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards 
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor 
 Must be able to communicate with customers/team members over the phone and in person 
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc. 
 
 Reasonable accommodation statement 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
